name: European long distance path E8 - part Bulgaria
description_md:
The European long distance path E8 - part Bulgaria is a hard, waymarked hiking route spanning 426.3 km in the international waymarked hiking network. It features 13181 m of ascent, 14370 m of descent, and takes about 143 hours on the DIN 33466 hiking time rule.

This country path is signposted as E8. The difficulty of the journey is derived from distance and ascent. Along the way, the path passes Trigrad Gorge within 200 m, Golyam Perelik within 500 m, and the Rhodope Mountains within 700 m.
